name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response relates to the previous statements and context of the conversation.

name: Engagement
description: Assesses the level of engagement the response creates in the conversation, including follow-up questions or comments that invite further discussion.
scale: 1-5 (1 = very low engagement, 5 = very high engagement)

name: Coherence
description: Evaluates the logical flow and clarity of the response in relation to the conversation, ensuring it makes sense and maintains the topic.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, including unique insights or unexpected angles that enhance the conversation.

name: Empathy
description: Assesses the emotional connection and understanding reflected in the response, considering the sentiments expressed by the conversation partner.
